dang rtswa chu sogs la dmigs nas de ltar ru gnas spor dgos byung ba zhig yin pas/ dud khrim zhig gis lo gcig gi ring la'ang mtsher sa thengs mang por spo dgos/ mtsher sa la dpyid sa dang / ston sa/ dgun sa/ bar sa zer ba sogs kyi dbye ba yod pa dang / mtsher sa re re nas zla ba dang nyi ma ci tsam la sdod par nges gtan chen po zhig med kyang / spyir btang gis dgun sa ru sdod yun ring zhing /dbyar sa sogs nas 'dug yun cung zad thung / de bas dbyar sa kho na nas kyang ru thengs du mar 'gel ba dang / ston sa bar sa sogs kyang de ltar yin/ 'on kyang mtsher sa de rnams la khyad par med pa zhig min par/ dpyid dus su chu rgyags sla ba dang sngo rtswa skye ba mgyogs pa'i chu 'gram dang lung mdo sogs su 'bab pa dang / dbyar dus la rtswa chu nyis 'dzoms yin pa'i sa bab mtho sa dag tu 'bab/dgun dus ri rdzob lung rdzob dang / ri skyibs yod pa/ kha ba babs kyang gnod skyon cher mi 'byung ba'i sa dang / gzhung chu dang chu mig la chab rom mi chags pa'i nye sar 'bab/ de la kha skad du nag shad zer/ da dung cung zad zhib mo byas te bshad na/ sngon dus dud khyim zhig gi ru dngos su ma bkal ba'i sngon la/ dud khyim rnams kyi khrim bdag ste skyes pa rnams thog mar mtsher sa gang legs la lta ru 'gro ba dang / mtsher la lta ba de ni don gyis mtsher sa dpyad du song ba yin zhing /de bas mtsher lta mkhan la nyams myong yod med kyi dbang gis mtsher sa la'ang khyad par dang bzang ngan yod mod/ spyir btang gis mtsher lta srol la nang don gtso bo 'di dag 'du ste/ spyi phyogs nas sa bab legs min dang / rtswa chu 'dzoms min/ rlung dang bser ba'i rgyu lam sogs la dpyad pa dang/ sgos su rgyab ri mdun lung dang / sa de zog la khams min/ mig gi lta lam yangs min/ zog la 'khor 361
yul yod med sogs la legs par dpyad thog spra phub sa dang / lug skyikha sa/rnar 'dogs sa/ tha na khyi 'dogs sa dang thal dbo sa sogs la'ang dpyad/ sngon chad skabs 'gar spyi tshogs bde 'jags min stabs/ mtsher la lta skabs da dung bzhud lam dang / nyag lam/ ri lam sogs la dpyad pa dang /mdor na jag rkun gyis len sla ba'i mtsher sa la gzab pa yin/ ru 'gel ba'i skabs su nam zla dang gza' skar 'phrod sbyor sogs la dpyad pa dang / de ni go rim dang 'char gzhi ldan pa zhig kyang yin/ dper na/ dud khyim zhig la sna ma(khal g.yag la zer)nyung zhing khal dos mang na sngon la 'or skal 'phen pa dang de nas khyim gzhi dngos su 'gel/ gal te lo lon(bgres po la go)dang byis pa mang na 'or skal dang mnyam du kho tsho mtsher sar skyel ba dang / yang na ru basprul rjes kho tsho len pa'ang yod pa sogs lta bu'o// ru ma bkal ba'i sngon la ca lag rnams bsdu gsog legs po byed pa dang / dos yas mas rnams kyi yang klu khrigs se gtong ba ma zad/ g.yag gang la dos gang 'gel ba dang de'i jib 'dogs ci dang gang byed rgyu sogs kyang 'char bkod byed/ nangs mor skyas myur du lam la chas slad snga dgong nas g.yag rnams la sga bstad nas thag pa bres te 'jog de yang khal 'gel dus spyir btang gis g.yag g.yung ma rnams la chos sgam dang / sbra/ phying snye/ sgam/ 'bru snye/zangs ma'adi ni sla nga dang / dkar yol/ thom bu sogs bsdu gsog byas pa'i snod skye la zer)byis pa rnams 'gel ba dang / de dag kyang g.yag re re la ngos btags byas yod/ g.yag rgod dang g.yag gsar(khal so ma phab pa'i g.yag la zer)rnams la ser sna'am sems chung cher byed mi dgos pa'i dos rnams 'gel/khal 'gel dus thag pa len srol sogs la'ang mnyam 'jog byed sa mang mod/362
'dir mang bar dogs nas bsdus so// ru 'gel ba'i nangs mor bza' mi tshang ma snga mo nas mal las langs shing / skyes pa rnams kyis khal 'gel ba dang skyes ma'am bud med rnams kyis 'bri bzho/ de ltar bya ba rnams phal cher tshags su tshud pa na bza' mi rnams go khar 'dus te skyas ja 'thung ba dang / de nas skyas rta rnams blangs nas sga bstod cing bsang yang gtong ngo // rta g.yung ma rnams la rgan pa dang byis pa skyon zhing rgod po rnams khyim bdag rang nyid dang na tshod thon pa'i gsar bu'am sman shar rnams kyis zhon/ nor rdang sna rdang bsdu ba dang btags khyi gtong ba sogs ni skyas lam du chas kha'i mtha' ma'i bya ba yin/ skyas bzhud skabs lug khyu sngon dang nor khyu dang mnyam du khal ma rnams 'ded/ skyas thag ring na lam bar nas bar zhag byed/ mtsher sar thon rjes mtsher ja skol ba'i zhar la khal rnams 'bogs/ de nas sbra phub ste sngon gyi 'jog lugs ltar do rtsig pa dang / nor rdang sogs 'then la/ do ni sang nangs rtsig pa'ang yod do//phyugs 'tsho skyong byed pa ni/ ru sde 'di'i dud khyim ga 'dra zhig yin na'ang /phyugs 'tsho mkhan nam zog rjes la 'gro mkhan ni phal cher skyes pa rnams yin la/skyes ma'ang yod/ sngon dus tsho dpon dang phyugs po rnams kyi skyes pa rnams zog la 'gro mkhan cung zad nyung zhing de dag gi zog rdzi mang shos ni dbul bo'am med po rnams te gla ba rnams yin/ khyim tshang phal mo ches rang zog rang gis 'tsho ba dang / dbyar ston la phyugs 'tsho sla zhing dgun dus cung zad dka'/ da dung dbyar ston la zog gtong 'dogs kyi las tshegs kyang cung chung bas/ dper na/dbyar ston la nor gyi mgo rgod(gnag las bzang po rnams la go)dang la lo(rta rgod ma sogs la go)phal cher gtong 'dogs mi byed par ri lung dag tu 'jug pa 363
lta bu ste/ de la kha skad du zog ri rgyag zer/ zog gtong 'dogs kyi skor la 'di ga'i bshad stangs ltar byas na/ nor 'dogs/ lug skyil/ la lo sprul zhes brjod do// sngon chad dud khyim cung phyug po zhig yin na/ lug stong lhag dang / nor brgyad cu dgu bcu/ la lo nyi shu sum cu yod/ phyug po rnams kyi phyugs grangs tshad gcig tu ma nges mod/ spyir btang gis ra lug mang zhing nor dang la lo cung zad nyung / dud khyim ha cang phyug po zhig yin na/ ra lug khri grangs la longs pa yod/lug khri grangs la bud na g.yang lug dang tshe thar gyi rwa ni dngul gyis shan te ston chen bshams/ de lta bu'i khyim tshang shin tu nyung bas/ bong stag dpon po rtam kho tshang lta bu 'ga' zhig las thos rgyu mi 'dug dud khyim cung zad dbul bo zhig yin na'ang / ra lug nyis brgya sum brgya tsam dang / nor bco lnga nyi shu/ la lo lnga drug tsam yod par bshad cing / lo rgyus thog bong stag 'dir ha cang dbul ba'i dud khyim mang po zhig med par mngon no// dus tshigs bzhi bo gang yin rung rdzi bo rnams nyi ma re rer zog rjes la 'gro dgos mod/ dbyar dus nyi ma ring zhing rtswa chu 'dzoms pa'i stabs kyis rdzi bo rnams kyis nangs snga mo nas rnar lug ri la ded de zog la rtswa rkang chags(nor lug gis rtswa zas te lto ba 'grang ba'i don)rjes/ nyin gong la lug khyu dang bzhon ma('bri mo)rnams phyir lhas la ded nas yong / de la gong lug dang gong bzho zer/ dbyar dus gong bzho brtsis na 'bri mo rnams nyin gcig rer thengs gsum la 'jo ba yin pasaskyes ma rnams kyi 'gan khur lhag par lci/ dbyar dus skyes pa rnams kyi las ka ches klu zhing dka' ba ni lug bal 'breg dgos pa de dang / da dung ra khul(khu lha)shad pa dang nor mid 'bal ba soṭa kyang las ka cung dka' ba'i rigs so// dbyar dus dang ston 364
dpyid la phyugs ni cung zad 'tsho sla bas byis pa dang rgan pa rnams kyang zog — rjes la 'bud pa dang / dbyar dus byis pa rnams phal cher be'u rdzi byed/ dgun dus rtswas ma 'dang ba dang / dbyar dus zog shed rgyas ched zog pa 'khyer ba'i srog yang yod/ dgun dus nam zla 'khyag cing grang ngar che bas zog ra skor/ de la rdo ra dang / spo ra/ klu ra/ nags ra/ gla ra sogs kyi khyad par yod la/ de rnams gtso bo dud khyim so so'i rang byung khor yug gam sdod gnas dang 'brel ba yod pas yin no// ra ba jig mkhan gtso bo skyes pa rnams yin la/ skyes mas kyang rtsig pa dang klu ra phal cher bud med rnams kyis rgyag zog ra mang che shos dgun sa ru jig pa dang / lug ra dang / rta ra/ be'u ra gsum ni zog ra gtso bo rnams yin/ dgun dus ni ma mo btsus pa'i dus kyang yin pas/ dus der ma mos lu gu len min dang / lu gu tsag gis 'khangs pa'am bor stor du 'gro ba/lu gu bya glag gis 'khyer ba sogs la lta ba'am dogs zon byed dgos stabs rdzi bo rnams la dka' ngal mang po yong / lu gu la dgun lug(dus ltar dgun la btsas pas de ltar brjod)dang / bkag lug(ma mo dus ltar lu gur 'gro ru ma bcug par btsas ran las brgal ba'i lu gu'i dpyid lug(rang bzhin gyis btsas 'phyi ba ste dpyid sgar btsas pa'i lu skyabacas kyi khyad par yod cing / de rnams las dgun lug bzang ba dang / bkag lug byas na lug gi 'phel kha myur yang ma mor sha shed rgyas par mi 'tsham/ dpyid lug ni nyung shas yin pa sogs shes sla bas zhib tu mi smra'o//bzhi/ rgyan pa dang 'dogs rgyan bza' bcang sga skor bshad pa/de yang bod mi spyi dang 'dra bar ru sde 'dir mtshon na'ang gyon pa gtso bo ni slog pa dang / tshar lu/ phrug lu/ stod gos/ ko lham sogs yin la/ de dag re re 365
byas te bshad na/ slog pa la dgun rtsag dang / ston rtsag dbyar rtsag tshar lu la dgun tshar dang / bar tshar/ dbong pa(dpung rgyas la zer)/ phrug la bod phrug dang / rgya phrug bal phrug sogs kyi khyad par yod de/ dgun rtsag ni dgun pags kyis bzos pa'i slog pa la zer ba dang / ston rtsag ni ston pags kyis bzos pa dang / dbyar rtsag ni dbyar dus su gyon pa'i slog pa la zer/ de rnams las ston pags kyis bzos pa'i slog pa ni rab tu baji la/ 'phyor lu'i tshab tu yang ston rtsag 'di gyon/ tshar lu las dgun tshar gyis bzos pa'i tshar lu bzang por brtsi ba dang / phrug lu ni bod phrug dang bal phrug gis bzos pa yin na legs por brtsi/ yang de rnams kyi gyon tshul sogs ni/ tshar lu dang phrug lu gnyis 'phyor lu byed cing slog pa ni rgyun du gyon/ de bas dud khyim phyug po zhig yin na bza' mi re re la tshar lu yod pa ma zad/ khyim tshang ha cang phyug po rnams la mi rer tshar lu phrug lu du ma yod pa'ang mchis/ dud khyim dbul bo rnams kyis kyang tshar lu dang phrug lu bzo bar ha cang mthong chen byed/ de ltar ma nus na'ang slog pa bzang po re ci nus kyis bzo ba yin/ sngon dus shin tu dbul bo rnams kyis ra rtsag dang / be'u rtsag re'u tshar sogs kyang gyon/ spyir ston rtsag ston dpyid la gyon pa dang / dgun rtsag dgun dus dang / dbyar rtsag dang ras lu gnyis dbyar dus su gyon zhing / dbyar rtsag la chu rtsag kyang zer/ de'i don ni slog pa rnams rnying rjes char chus brlan yang ser sna byed mi dgos par dbyar dus la gyon pas de ltar btags/ char ba 'bab dus phying lu gyon/ tshar lu dang phrug lu ni lo sar dang ston mo sogs kyi dus su gyon la/ da dung phyug po rnams la spyang tshar dang / wa tshar/ tshar nag gi tshar lu sogs kyang yod pas/ gyon tshul ni ha 366
lam tshar lu sogs dang 'dra'o// gong bshad ltar slog pa bzo byed rab tu gyur ba ni ston pags yin pas/ des slog pa bzos na gcig nas spu'i srab mthug ran pa dang gnyis nas pags pa mnyes pa legs na 'phyor lu'ang nyan/ de bas bshad rgyun la yang tshar lu ngan ngon zhig gyon pa las rtsag pa yag pa zhig gyon na bzang zer/ yang pho rtsag dang mo rtsag pho tshar dang mo tshar zer ba ltar/ skyes pa dang skyes ma rnams kyi lu bar khyad par shin tu che bas/ de dag gi gcod srol bzo lugs dang pags pa tshar ru'i mang nyung yang mi 'dra/ dper na/ mo lu'i khobs che zhing thur la ring ba dang / gong ba gong tsog dang phu thung cung zad thung /pho lu'i khobs che yang thur la thung / gong ba gong shad dang phu thung cung zad ring ba lta bu ste/ mo lu che na tsha ru lnga bcu dang pags pa brgyad lhag dang / pho lu che na tsha ru bzhi bcu dang pags pa bdun tsam dgos pas/ mo lu'i 'gro sgo che zhing pho lu'i 'gro sgo nyung ngo // sngon dus stod gos sogs rang gis bzo la/ de'i gcod tshul ni gong ba cung zad yar bslangs pa'i tshul du yod pa dang / phu thung ring zhing 'dab kha cung zad thung / sgrog long dang yang na sgrog gu tshang ma stod gos ni rgyu gang 'dra zhig gis bzos pa yin na de'i ras sne dang gos snes byed/ sne ni ras dang gos kyi dum bur go la/ stod gos la 'di ga'i mi mang che bas tshi len zhes brjod/ gos kyi tshi len ni lo sar dang ston mo sogs kyi dus su gyon pa dang ras kyi tshi len ni rgyun du gyon/ sngon dus skyes ma rnams la tshi len las rkang snam med/ skyes pa rnams kyis tshi len dang rkang snam gnyis ka gyon yang / dbul bo rnams kyis tshi len ma khugs pas dpung rjen la'ang 'gro/ dgun dus rtsag 'bas(pags pas bzos pa'i rkang snam la zer)gyon/ 'di ga'i kha skad du rkang 367
snam la bug 'bas zer bas ras 'bas rtsag 'bas zhes te brjod/ bug 'bas zhes pa 'di ni kha skad du pus mo la bug mo zer bas rkang snam ni pus mo sbed byed yin pas pus sbed ces pa'i sgra zur chag pa yin nam snyam/ dbyar dgun ston dpyid gang yin yang skyes pho mo gon gzhon tshang mas lham gyon pa dang /lham gtso bo a mdo'i ko lham yin zhing / lha sa'i 'bol ril dang rgya lham gyon pa'ang yod/ lham la pho lham mo lham gyi khyad par yod/ lham tshang la rtswa 'joglham sgrog bal gyis sgril/ rkang 'bom mi dar bas lham gyis brdar na ras rnying sogs kyis rkang ba btums/ dbyar dus rkang rjen la 'gro ba'ang yod do// de yang bod mi rnams kyis lu ba mdzes min la ha cang gtsiṭa mthong byed pa ltar/ru sde 'di yab de las ma 'das par slog ṇḍa sogs kyi kha ru rgyan spras byed/ de la kha skad du kha khyen zer/ slog pa'i kha 'phyor du ras dang / tshar lu dang phrug lu'i kha la sum rgyag pho lu dang mo lu la khyad par yod pas/ kha 'phyor rgyag tshul yang mi 'dra ste/ pho lu'i kha 'phyor chung zhing mo lu'i kha 'phyor che la/ pho lur nyis 'phyor dang mo lur sum 'phyor rgyag snga ma ni ras dang shur ma'am khyi lang nag po mtho gang gi gsham du ras dkar po sor gang dang yang na phrug khra rgyag pa la zer ba dang / phyi ma ni gong du ras ljang gu sor lnga tsam dang bar du ras sam khri lang shur ma dmar po mtho gang dang de'i gsham du ras dkar po'am phrug khra sor gsume nas lnga tsam rgyag pa bcas la zer/ tshar lu dang phrug lu'i kha ru sum mtho gang dang de'i gong du cang khyib sor bzhi lnga tsam rgyag pa dang / pho lu dang mo lu'i sram la che chung btod mod phal cher de ltar yin/ sngon dus phyug po dang dbul bo rnams kyi gyon pa la khyad par chen po yod pas/ phyug po rnams kyi tshar lu'i 368
g.yogs dang kha yi sram sogs che zhing / dbul bo rnams kyis de ltar mi nus pas lu mtha'i sram sogs chung / gong gsal gyi lu ba rnams dang / kha 'phyor/sram sogs kyi gcod srolta bzo lugs rnams 'dir yi ger 'jigs nas bsdus so// 'dogs rgyan gyi skor cung zad bshad pa la/ rna rgyan dang / tshags skyor/ skra shubs/ dmar rgyan/ glo gzur/ ske rgyan/ lag gdub/ sor gdub/ gri/ ja la(ca la)sogs yin te/ 'di ga'i yul skad du rna rgyan dang / lag gdub/ sor gdub so so la rna long dang / lag mgo mdzub dkris zhes 'bod pa khyab che/ rna long la gser dngul dang g.yu byur sogs mi 'dra ba'i rna long mang po yod kyang /gser dngul rkyang ba'i rna long rin gong mtho bas phyug po nyung shas kyi skyes ma rnams kyis ma gtogs bzu mi thub pas gser dngul gyi rna long 'dogs mkhan nyung / skyes ma mang che bas g.yu dang byu ru'i phra can gyi rna long 'dogs/ sngon dus ru sde 'di'i skyes bu nyung shas kyis kyang rna long 'dogs pa'i srol yod par bshad/ tshags skyor ni phyi ma gos dang nang ma ras byas te bzos pa'i rgyan cha zhig ste/ de'i steng du g.yu dang byu ru rnams 'phred du bshar nas btsims pa dang la la'i steng du g.yu byur gyi bshar phreng dang mnyam du dngul gyi dung tsi'ang 'dogs/ spa ni lan bu mang po byas nas bslus rjes lan bu rnams kyi sne mo tshags skyor gyi tshags long du btags te skra mtha' yongs su bskor nas yod pas/phyi tshul nas bltas na zlum gor gyi dbyibs su snang la/ tshags skyor ni skyes ma rnams kyis mgo ru 'dogs pa'i rgyan gtso bo zhig yin la/ des rgyan cha'i go chod pa dang mnyam du lan bu rnams kyi sne mo bzung ste de rnams mi lhod mi 'thor pa'i dus pa thon/ skyes ma rnams kyis skra bslus te lan bu rnams kyi sne mo rim bzhin 369
phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas skra shubs su 'jug pa dang rgyab nas thur du dpyangs/de ni tshags skyor dang skra shubs gnyis mi mtshungs pa'i khyad par yin yang / skra shubs kyi steng du'ang g.yu dang byu ru dang dung tsi sogs 'dogs pa ma zad/ sne mor ja la(ca la)dang dar gos sogs kyang 'dogs/ sngon chad ru sde 'di'i skyes ma rnams la mtshon na tshags skyor 'dogs mkhan mang zhing skra shubs 'dogs mkhan nyung / de min skyes ma tsho'i rgyan cha gtso po gzhan zhig ni dmar rgyan yin zhing / 'di ga'i kha skad du dmar ldan zer/ de'i rin gong yang ha cang mtho/dmar ldan gyi dbyibs ni gsham 'og cung zad che zhing steng gong gi zheng ni cung zad phra/ spyir dmar ldan gyi che chung ring thung sogs skyes ma rang gi lus tshad ltar byas pa zhig yin pas tshang ma gcig mtshungs min/ dmar ldan gyi bzo stangs ni/ thog mar ras dmar po zhig la phyi nang sprad de bzo ba dang / de'i steng dngul dung du ma bsgrigs te 'dogs/ skra phab pa'i dmar ldan gyi mgo ni thom mgo yin/ skra ma phab pa'i dmar ldan gyi mgo ni gru bzhi yin/ phyag dung gnyis dang dkyis dung gcig ste gsum yod/ phrag dung gis ming bo mtshon zhing /dkyil dung gis khyo ga mtshon/ ming bo shi na phyag dung mi 'dogs/ skyes pa shi na dmar ldan dang bcas pa len pa'am mi 'dogs/ gong 'og yas mas rnams su dngul dung chung ngu dang byu ru rnams 'dogs la/ dmar ldan gyi steng du rgyan cha de 'dra mang po yod pas klu tshad kyang nges can zhig yod/ mdor na dmar ldan gyi zheng ni skyes ma rang gi rgyab zheng gi tshad dang ring thung yang phal cher rang gi lus tshad dang mnyam/ 'dogs dus long bu ske la gyon pa dang rgyab tu btags nas thur la dpyangs yod/ glo gzur dang bzho zung yang skyes ma rnams kyi rgyan cha 370
gtso bo'i rigs te/ glo gzur gyi rgyu cha dngul yin zhing / de la che chung mi 'dra ba mang po yod/ mang che ba'i dbyibs ni gor gor dang gru bzhi yin pa'ang yod kyang nyung / dngul smug dang dngul dkar gnyis las snga mas brdungs pa'i glo gzur bzho zung bzang por brtsi/ glo gzur dang bzho zung gi nang khog shing dang long bu ko bas byed/ steng du g.yu byur gyi phra 'jog da dung glo gzur gyi mdzo sna'i nang du dar gos dang ja la sogs len/ sngon dus phyug po'i bu mo dang mna' ma yin na glo gzur bzho zung du ma yod pas/ rgyun du glo gzur gcig las mi 'dogs kyang / ston mo sogs kyi skabs su glo gzur gnyis 'dogs pa'i srol yang yod/de ni don la rgyan cha ngom pa yin pas/ glo gzur kho na ma yin par dmar ldan dang bzho zung sogs kyi bzang ngan che chung sogs kyang gshib mod/ dbul bo rnams kyis de 'dra mi nus/ de sngon skyes pa rnams kyis kyang glo gri dang me cha len byed kyi glo gzur chung ngu 'dogs pa dang gri ring ni mang che bas 'dogs/ ral ba'i nang du ja la len/ skyes pho mo tshang mas mdzub dkris gyon pa dang / dngul dang ba so'i lag gdub bzang por baji/ lag gdub la 'di ga'i kha skad du lag mgo zer/ skyes ma tshang mas ske rgyan 'dogs kyang / skyes pa rnams la de 'dra mi dar ba 'dra'o// da ni bza' btung skor cung zad bshad na/ ru sde 'dis kha zas su spyod pa'i bza' btung gtso bo yang bod mi gzhan rnams dang 'dra bar mar dang / chur ba/ rtsam pa/ sha go re/ ja sogs yin/ mar len tshul ni/ 'bri mo rnams skyes ma dag gis bzho zhing skyes pas bzho ba'ang yod kyang de ni nyung shas yin/ 'o ma bzhos rjes 'o ma drod 'jam byas te zo ba'i nang sdugs pa dang / da dung zho dang 'o kha'o giyang sdugs/ 'o ma dkrug skabs 'khyag mi nyan pas zo 371
ba nyi ngogs su 'jog 'o rtas dkrug nas mar len/ de yang stong dkrug 'o ma'i mar lo zhes pa ltar zo ba'i nang gi 'o ma de thengs grangs mang po zhig la dkrug dgos mod/ zo ba'i che chung dang / 'o ma'i mang nyung / da dung nam zla'i drod grang sogs kyi dbang gis mar 'bud tshul gcig gi 'o ma dkrug thengs de grangs stong gcig gi yas mas yin pa las mtha' gcig tu ma nges la/ 'di ga'i kha skad du 'o ma dkrug pa la 'o ma phyug zer/ nam rgyun 'bri mar dang ra mar len pa las rgon mar dang rnga mar len srol med/ mar blangs rjes kyi 'o ma la dar ba zer/dar ba bskol nas chur ba len/ chur ba khod dang phyar khyad du brdal te nyi mar skem/ chur ba blangs shul gyi chur khu khyi dang zog la sdud/ nas brngo ba dang lag skor la brten nas rtsam pa 'thag pa 'di bod mi gzhan rnams kyi byed tshul dang mtshungs pas/ sngon 'di ga'i dud khyim phal mo che la rdo ba'i lag skor yod/ rtsam pa za dus mar chur dang mnyam du bsres te za/ dkar yol gyi nang rtsam pa phyed tsam dang / de'i steng chur ba nyung tsam dang / da dung mar cung zad chung ngu zhig 'phangs te de rnams kyi steng la ja blugs nas 'thung ba la gtol ma zer 'og tu ja nyung ngu dang de nas mar che tsam/ de'i steng rtsam pa dang chur ba mang po blugs te brdzis nas za ba la rtsam pa zer/ nangs ja dang phyir ja'i skabs su gtol ma za la/ dros ja dang / zog ja/ lam thag ring por 'gro khar rtsam pa za/spyir btang gis khyim tshang mang che bas de ltar byed kyang / bshad srol la stag shar bas nangs rtsam mi za/ sman bu mos nangs zho mi 'thung zhes pa ltar nangs ja'i kha nas rtsam pa mi za ba las gzhan ja kha rnams kyi skabs su khyad par chen po med do// rtsam pa dus rgyun mar gyis brdzi ba khyab che yang / da dung g.yas dang /372
zhag dang / 'o kha sogs kyis kyang brdzi bas/ g.yas rtsam/ zhag rtsam/ 'o rtsam zhes brjod la/ sngon chad rma la bzhir sa lko la song dus gtso bo g.yas rtsam 'di la brten par bshad/ nub ja'i skabs su sha za zhing lda gu 'thung ba dang / nas thug 'bras thug rtsam thug rnams kyang 'thung / de dag la 'di ga'i kha skad du nas kho(khu)'bras kho rtsam kho zhes brjod do// sha rigs gtso bo skam sha dang /lug sha na sha sgo sha kyang sha ri bong gi sha sogs za/ dgun dus su skam lug skor zhig bshus te sha la nyar tshags legs po byed/ de la kha skad du o ci zer/de ni dpyid dus la slebs skabs sha tshon po za bar dka' ngal mi yong ba'i ched du yin/ rta sha dang / rnga sha nya sha sprung sha bya 'a khyi sha sogs za ba'i srol med/sha btsos ma dang bskam ma za/ gzhan yang zhun dang / thud/ go re/ nyog gro ma/'bras sogs za/ gro ma dang / chur ba/ ka ra mar sogs bsres nas byas pa la zhun zer/ zhun ni gtso bo dgun dus ldugs/ phye dang chur ba mnyam du g.yos te dum bur bgos nas bskam pa la thud ces bya la/ khol ma'i skabs su'ang zas chog de la phye thud zer/ phye thud chu'i nang du btso ba dang nyog ni phye dang chur ba bsres nas g.yo/ go re la go re dmar po dang / sreg gor/ skya leb sogs yod de/g.yas kyis btsos pa la go re dmar po zer ba dang / de la yang go re rgyab lag ma dang / de'u ril/ lo rgya ste bca' stangs mi 'dra ba 'ga' zhig mchis/ sreg gor skya leb sogs go sla yang / sngon dus go re sreg byed kyi snod med pas thal 'og tu bcug nas sreg de min zho dang / 'o ma/ spri('bri mo dang ma mo sogs btsas rjes kyi thog ma'i 'o ma la zer)'o ja/ nag drig sogs 'thung ba dang / 'o ma ma bsres pa'i ja la 'di ga'i kha skad du nag drig zer/ bza' btung g.yo 373
skol gyi skabs su tshwa dang / ja/ g.yer ma/ ca sga sogs la ha cang mthong chen byed/sngon dus de rnams shin tu nyo dka' bar bshad do//lnga/ lo sar dang gnyen ston sogs bshad pa/bgres po rnams kyi ngag sgros ltar na/ sngon dus ru sde 'dis kyang bod lugs ltar lo sar ba'i dga' ston bsu bar bshad kyang / dus nam zhig nas bzung lugs srol de nyams pa'am bskyur te lugs rnying gi rtsi tshul ltar lo sar bsu ba'i lugs de ni ha cang khyab gdal du gyur/ dud khyim phyug po dang dbul po gar zhig yin yang lo sar la ha cang mthong chen byed/ lo ma sar ba'i sngon gyi nyi ma gsum bzhi'i dus nas bzung rang rang gi 'dzom tshod ltar gra sgrig phun sum tshogs pa byed/ lo sar la nges par mkho zhing sta gon byed dgos pa'i bya ba rnams ni bsang khri'i kha bstod pa dang / go re btso ba/ tshong la 'gro ba/ lug bsha' ba/ stod gos sogs gsar ba bzo ba/ tshar lu sogs dang dkar yol gsar ba rnams sgam las 'don pa/ chos sprugs byed pa/ thab ka la sa byugs gsar rgyag byed pa/ chu thag ring na snga mo nas dar len pa/ rta 'dzin pa sogs te/ mdor na nyi shu dgu nas gnam gang gi bar thams cad tshags su tshud par byed pa de yin/ chos sprugs byed pa'i nyin ni bod lo'i nyi shu dgu yin la/ chos sprugs zhes pa ni ya logs su bshams pa'i thang ga sogs dang chos sgam du bcug pa'i chos dpe rnams blangs te de dag gi steng du dud pa dang sa rdul chags yod med tshang mar rdul sprugs thengs gcig byed pa dang / rdul sprugs byas rjes slar yang bshams pa'am sgam du bcug nas mnol bsang dang shug pa btug ste 'jog go/ rdul sprugs zhes pa ni sbra ngos kyi dud pa dang dos steng gi sa rdul thams cad ma lus par sprugs pa de yin zhing / rdul sprugs yongs su byas tshar 374
rjes khyim yang gtsang mar phyags pa dang / gad snyigs yod tshad phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas thal gzhong sogs snod du bcu mod/ 'on kyang rdul sprugs byas pa'i gad snyigs de nam rgyun ltar thal spungs su mi 'bo bar/ thog mar lo de'i lo lha gang du yod par dpyad/ gal te lo lha lho na yod na lo lha med pa'i phyogs la dbo ba yin pas/ lo re re'i rdul sprugs kyi gad snyigs rnams dbo phyogs mi 'dra/ nyi shu dgu'i dgong mor nub ja la dgu thug skol/ sha dang / nas/ sran ma/ gro ma/'bras/ rtsam pa/ chur ba/ phye sogs sna kha mang po tshang ba'i thug pa zhig yin pas de skad zer/ rdul sprugs byed pa dang dgu thug skol ba de la nang don med pa zhig min te/ dud rdul sprugs pa de ni 'das pa'i lo gcig gi ring mi la na tsha dang phyugs la god kha byung ba'am ma byung na'ang de lta'i bkra mi shis pa'i don 'dra yin na ni dud rdul rnams dang 'dra bar drungs dang rtsa ba nas bkog ste ring por dor te lo gsar ba'i nang de dang de lta bu'i gnod 'tshe dang bar chad sogs ci yang med par bkra shis g.yang gis khyakha par kun nas smon pa'i sems 'dun mtshon pa yin la/ dgu thug skol ba de yang 'das pa'i lo gcig gi ring med mug ci yang ma byung bar 'tsho ba ni phun sum tshogs pa sna kha ma 'dus pa med pa 'dzoms dgu yin pa mtshon thog lo rjes ma'i dus su yang de ltar phun sum tshogs shing 'dzom po yong ba lo lhar bcol ba'i rtags mtshan yin la/ dgu thug btung ba'i skabs su lo lhas rgya mar tshad 'jal byed par nges zhes mi che chung tshang mas thug pa rgyags re btung / rgya lo'i tshes gcig gi nangs mor bza' mi rgan gzhon tshang ma snga mo nas mal las langs/ phan tshun la lo sar 'tshams 'dri byed/ skyes pa rnams kyis bsang gtong ba dang mchod pa bshams/ skyes ma rnams 375
kyis ja skol ba dang mnyam du sder kha sgrig lo ja ma 'thung ba'i sngon la bza' mi tshang ma thang ga mchod pa'i mdun du song ste phyag 'tshal ba dang chos bton te smon lam bzang po 'debs/ lo ja btung rjes g.yag la sga 'bog byed cing rta gong la 'bud/ de nas khyim tshang gzhan par lo sar la 'gro/ de yang bla ma dang /dpon po/ rgan pa rnams kyi lo sar la sngon du 'gro ba dang / rang dang lo na mnyam pa'am chung ba rnams kyi lo sar rjes ma byed/ lo sar rten 'brel la 'khyer rgyu'i dngos po ni gos dang / kha btags/ dkar yol/ zhun/ lo rgya sogs yin la/ pha rol pas lo sar la phyir ster ba'i dngos po rnams kyang de rnams yin/spyir rgya lo'i tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar phan tshun gyi lo sar la 'gro mod/tshes gnyis la chi tshag dang tshes pa bdun dang brgyad gnyis la nag chen dang nag chung zer bas de rnams kyi skabs su phan tshun gyi lo sar la 'gro mkhan shin tu nyung / ru sde 'dir mtshon na/ lo re'i lo sar ni ha cang gal che ba'i dus chen zhig la brtsi ba las bod kyi dus chen gzhan dag la de 'dra'i mthong chen mi byed pas phal cher tshang ma nyams 'dug go/ chos lugs kyi byed sgo'i phyogs nas sngon chad ru sde 'dir yang cung dar zhing cha tshang bas de rnams bong stag dgon pa sogs kyi lo rgyus skabs su chos thog so so'i gtong lugs bris yod pas de dag las shes bar bya'o// yang gnyen ston sogs cung zad bshad na/ ston mo'i rigs la gnyen ston dang / gya ston/ ne'u ston/ btsas ston bcas yod la/ gya ston dang ne'u ston lo sar skabs kyi tshes bzang po ste tshes gcig dang / gsum/lnga/ bcu gcig bco lnga rnams las gang rung zhig gdam nas ston mo bshams/snga ma ni bgres po rnams lo brgyad cur bud pa'i rten 'brel gyi ston mo la zer ba 376
dang / phyi ma ni byis pa lo gsum la bud pa'i rten 'brel gyi ston mo yin la/ dus der byis pa'i de'u skra len/ byis pa'i ne'u skra ni mi gang yin zhig gis blangs mi chog pas de la rtags dang rten 'brel dpyad rgyu mang / gnyen ston mang che ba'ang gong gsal gyi tshes bzang po de dag gi nyin la byed mod/ tshang ma gcig tu ma nges pas zla ba gang rung zhig gi gong bshad kyi tshes bzang de dag las da dung tshes bcu bdun dang / nyer gnyis/ nyer lnga gang rung zhig la gtad de gnyen ston bgyid/ sngon dus ru sde 'di'i dpon po'am phyug po'i khyim tshang la bu skyes na btsas ston byed srol yod par bshad kyang / yongs khyab la srol 'di mi dar ba'am nyams song ba yin pa cha ma 'tshal lo/ gang ltar kha dpe la bu zhig skyes na bsang zhig gtong zhes pa ltar dud khyim ga 'dra zhig yin yang de la bu skyes na bsang gtong ba'i srog 'dug go/ gnyen ston gyi sngon la gnyen slong ba dang ston mor gra sgrig gang legs byed/ de ni rgyu'i gtong sgo che zhing las ka mang ba'i bya ba zhig kyang yin/ gnyen ya la mag pa'am mna' ma slong skabs de la slong mi gtso bo zhig 'gro dgos/ dper na/ dud khyim zhig gis khyim tshang gzhan zhig gi bu mo mna' mar slong na/ dud khyim de'i khyim bdag rang nyid dang yang na de'i spun dang / chung ma len ran pa'i bu de'i a zhang rnams las gcig ni gnyen slong du 'gro/ gal te sde ba mi 'dra ba'i khyim tshang gnyis kyi gnyen don yin na/ slong mkhan phyogs kyi sde ba de'i dpon po dang yang na rgad po ming can zhig tshab tu 'gro/ slong yul gyi khyim tshang der mtshon na/ bu mo de gnas la ster min la dbang yod mkhan ni de'i pha ma dang / a khu/ a zhang / ming bo sogs yin/ mag pa slong na'ang phyogs gnyis kyi 'gro lugs de ltar yin no// gnyen slong ba'i nyi mar 377
shin tu brtag cing dpyad/ gnyen slong dus slong rten du 'khyer dgos pa'i legs skyes ni dar gos dang / kha btags/ chang rnams yin la/ gal te pha rol pa yid mthun byung na gnyen chang gi kha phyes te rten 'brel mgo nas 'grig pa'i rtags su chang 'thung / yid mthun ma byung na gnyen chang mi 'thung la slong rten yang mi len/ slong thengs dang por mna' ma'am mag pa ma byin na thengs gnyis pa gsum par slong ba yang yod/ spyir gnyen ni 'grig pa mang zhing gtan nas mi 'grig pa yang yod/ gnyen 'grig rjes gnyen mi zlog gnyen zlog na gnyen zlog la rgyu dngos mang po gtong dgos/ phyogs gnyis po gnyen don la yid mthun byung na/ skabs de dang bstun nas dus nam zhig la ston mo bya rgyu dang / a zhang du yong ba/ 'bab rten dgos min/ ston mo'i che chung ga 'dra byed pa/ slong bya'i mag pa'am mna' ma der rgyan gos sogs ci 'dra dgos pa'i thad la gros bsdur byed/ skabs 'gar nyi ma bzang po zhig logs su gdam ste de dag gi skor la zhib gros byed pa'ang yod/ de bas gal te mna' ma bslangs pa yin na/ slong mkhan gyi phyogs nas bu mo der gos tshar dang / thog lu/ zhwa mo/ lham sogs gyon chas dang / da dung dmar ldan dang / tshags skyor/ ske rgyan/ rna long / glo gzur/bzho zung sogs 'dogs rgyan ma tshang ba med pa gra sgrig byed dgos/ mag pa yin na/ gos tshar dang / thog lu/ zhwa mo/ lham sogs gyon pa dang / ske rgyan dang /ga'u/ glo gri sogs tshags su tshud dgos/ de rnams kyis chog min dang de dag ga 'dra yin dgos par re ba 'don mkhan ni mna' ma'am mag pa gang de'i pha ma sogs gong bshad kyi mi sna gtso bo de rnams yin pas/ phyogs gnyis gnyen don la yid mthun byung yang / skabs 'gar de rnams kyi thad nas rtsod pa byung ba'ang 378
mchis/ de bas sngon dus phyug pos phyug por gnyen byed pa mang la/ med pos med por gnyen sdeb pa yin dzo// gnyen skyel skabs a zhang gtso che/ a zhang zhes pa ni mag pa'am mna' mar skyel ma byas te yong ba'i nye tshan rnams la zer bas/nam rgyun gyi a zhang zer ba dang khyad par yod mod/ mag pa'am mna' ma skyel skabs de'i a zhang mi 'gro ba min la/ gang de'i a zhang dang ming bo sogs ni skyel mar yong ba'i a zhang rnams las kyang gtso bo dag yin/ gal te sde ba mi 'dra ba gnyis kyis gnyen byas pa yin na/ a zhang la 'gro mkhan ni mna' ma'am mag pa'i nye du rnams gtso bo yin thog sde ba gnyis bar gyi khog dpung dang la rgya mtshon phyir/ sde ba de'i dpon po dang / phyug po/ rgad po ming can rnams kyang 'gro/ a zhang la skyes pa rnams 'gro ba las skyes ma 'gro ba'i srol ru sde 'dir mi dar/ a zhang nyung na gsum nas lnga dang mang na nyer gcig sogs mi 'dra/ spyir dpon po dang / phyug po/ sde ba'i bar gyi gnyen don yin na a zhang mang ba dang /dbul bo dang yang na khyim mtsho ru skor bar gyi gnyen don yin na a zhang nyung ngo /mag par skyel ma byed mkhan la 'di ga'i yul srol du gnyen tshang tshang yang zer/gnyen slong mkhan gyi phyogs nas ston ma'i 'gan 'khur ba dang / mag pa'am mna' ma de phar skyel tshur len byed dgos na phyogs gnyis kus 'khur/ mi che chung tshang ma ston mor 'bod/ de yang gnyen ston ga 'dra zhig byed rgyu ni gnyen ya'i phyogs na a zhang ci tsam yod pa sogs la gzhigs te sta gon bgyi/ sngon gyi srol ltar na/ ston mo'i bza' btung la nges par mkho ba sha dang / go re/ ka ra/chang sogs dang / da /shā nga a zhang ci tsam yod na tshang ra de tsam dgos/ tshang ra 'jog dus tshang rnga phyi dang tshang mgo mgron por bskor/ skyes 'bul('di ga'i kha 379
skad du lag 'jog zer)gyi phyogs nas a zhang ci tsam yod na de dag tshang mar dar gos dang / mna' ma'am mag pa'i nye du rnams la dmigs gsal gyi khyad par btod de skyes chen po 'bul/ de min ston mor yong mkhan tshang mar gos dang / kha btags/ go re/ ka ra sogs skyes chung ngu ster zhing / skabs 'dir phyug po'i ston mor yong ba'i med po tsho'ang lag stong la 'jug pa'i srol mi dar/ston mo'i sngon la/ ston 'go 'dzin mkhan dang / ston bshad byed mkhan/ ja chang 'dren mkhan/ glu len mkhan/ mag skegs bcings mkhan/ rta kha len mkhan sogs te mi skor zhig kyang rtsa 'dzugs byed/ de rnams la ston 'dzin pa zer/ tha snyad 'di ni phyis su ston mor yong mkhan yod tshad la ngos 'dzin pa'ang yod/ nye du rnams las rigs rus thob thang cung zad mtho zhing gtam la mkhas pa zhig gis ston 'go 'dzin pa dang / khyim bdag rang nyid byed pa'ang yod/ de la 'di ga'i yul skad du kha brda byed mkhan zer/sde ba gnyis bar gyi gnyen don yin na sde ba'i dpon po dang phyug po'am rgad po ngo chen zhig gis tshab byas na'ang chog ja skol ba ni ston mo'i dus kyi bya ba gal chen zhig yin pas/ ja ma ni skyes ma gang yin la mi gtad/ de ni rang phyogs nye tshan gyi skyes ma rnams las bud med lo na cung zad che zhing bu dang bu mo mang ba dang / g.yug dang las ka yod pa/ zas g.yo sbyor dang dkar 'o len la mkhas pa zhig yin dgos/ ston mo'i dus su phyogs kha gnyis kyis ja mar phyag dar 'phen/ gnyen tshang gis phyag g.yas pa dang a zhang tshang gis phyag g.yon par 'phen/ ja ma la bstod pa mang du byed/ yang skyes pa lo na che zhing dus rgyun kha las dge ba dang / bu dang bu mo mang zhing dpa' dang snying stobs ldan pa/ rgyu 380
dang 'byor bas phyug pa zhig gis mag skegs bcings/ ska rags bcing srol dang bcing dus kha g.yang mang po 'bod pa sogs bsdus/ glu len mkhan rnams la rgan gzhon dang pho mo'i khyad par med mod/ gtso bo skad ngag bde zhing klu la mkhas dgos/ klu tshar na tshar mkhan gyi zhwa len/ rta kha len mkhan la rigs gnyis su phye chog ste/ cig shos ni bag ma'am mag pa'i rta kha len mkhan yin la/de yang lo snying dang spar kha na tshod sogs la dpyad nas bkod sgrig byed/ de'i 'gan khur ni bag ma'am mag pa'i rta kha len dgos pa las da dung mag pa'am bag mar bshad rogs dang 'dug rogs bya dgos pas mag rogs bag rogs zhes kyang bya/ skabs 'gar bag rogs mag rogs dang rta kha len mkhan so sor byed pa'ang mchis/ gnyen ston byed pa'i nyin mor gnyen skyel mkhan gyi phyogs nas kyang bag rogs sam mag rogs shig bkod sgrig byas yod pas/ bag ma'am mag pa slebs ma thag rta kha len mkhan gyis kha btags 'bul zhor myur du rta kha len/ dus der pha rol pas bag ma'am mag pa'i rta'i srab mda' rang dgar mi sprod pas/ phyogs gnyis kos phan tshun la blo ris dang lag myur sogs 'gran res byed/ mthar gnyen slong mkhan gyi phyogs de rgyal dgos pa dang ma rgyal na'ang bag rta'am mag rta'i srab mda' gnyen slong mkhan gyi phyogs der sprod/bag rta dang mag rta phal cher ra ra byed/ gzhan zhig ni a zhang tshang gi rta kha len mkhan rnams yin te/ a zhang re re la rta kha len mkhan re re yod/ rta kha len dus gang 'dod ci 'dod kyis mi len par/ rang rang gi lo tshod dang thob thang sogs ha lam 'dra ba byas te rta kha len no// yang gnyen skyel mkhan gyi phyogs tsam bshad na/ rang gi bu'am bu mo de phar la skyel khar/ bu mo yin na/ bu mo'i 381
ria ma dang yang na nye du'i skyes ma gang phyogs nas 'bur du thon pa zhig gis bu mo'i skra bslus te skra phab pa dang / de dang mnyam du pha ma zung dang ming bo sogs kyis gnas la 'gro dgos tshul dang / gnas nas chags dgos tshul/ a ne a mes skud mo sogs la byams shing mthun dgos tshul/ bu skyong khyim las la 'bad dgos tshul sogs kha brda byas te zhal ta gtong / zhal ta gtong tshul gyi tshig sogs bsdus/ bu mo la rang gi 'dzom tshod kyis rdzong ba ster/ de la bu mo'i rang zer/ bu yin na de'i a pha zhang bo phu nu rnams kyis song sa nas kha las dge ba dang / bsdad sa nas gral mgo non pa/ mngags sa nas go chod pa/ skyid kyang kha pho chung ba/ sdug kyang mgo 'phang mtho ba/ pha shul bus bzung 'dra/ nags mo stag gis bzung 'dra zhig yong dgos pa sogs zhal ta yang yang byed/ bu la gos sogs kyi rdzong ba ster/ de la bu yi rang zer/ phyug po dang dpon po'i bu yin na rta dang bo'u dang bcas pa ster ro// gnyen ston gyi nyin mor phyogs kha gnyis kyis snga mo nas bsang gtong zhing smon lam bzang po 'debs/ mna' ma'am mag pa gang yin yang snga dror gnyen ya'i khyim du 'dzul ba las phyi dro'i dus su khyim la 'dzul ba'i dpe mi srid/ lam thag ring na'ang bar zhag byas te ston mo'i nyin mor nyin gong la ma slebs gong nye ya'i khyim du 'dzul/ a zhang rnams nye ya'i khyim du 'dzul ba'i bar du nye ya'i phyogs nas de tsho'i sngon bsu la mchod kha thengs gsum 'khyer ba dang / skabs 'gar ja thab rgyag pa'ang yod/ mchod kha 'khyer thengs re rer nye ya'i phyogs nas a zhang rnams la 'tshams 'dri dang de nas mnyam du bsang rtsi zhing mchod kha 'phen/ de dag gi skabs su phan tshun bar rta yi bang kha myur min dang bu yi rig pa gsal min sogs la nyams tshod kyang 382
mang du brtag de la 'di ga'i kha skad du dkris skor 'khyer ba zhes brjod/ de bas phyogs kha gnyis la bu rta bzang po mang du dgos/ a zhang rnams sbra'i nye sar slobs dus nye ya'i phyogs nas 'tshams 'dri dang bcas te rta kha len/ khyim du bsus rjes dang thog ja 'dren pa las sder kha mang po mi 'jog de nas a zhang rnams tshogs grol ba ltar sgor bud de cung zad g.yeng / skabs de dang bstun nas nang gros yod na gros byed pa dang bu'am bu mor byin pa'i rdzong ba rnams kyang dus der rta'i sha thag las len/ skabs der nye ya'i phyogs nas kyang 'tshag med pa'i don 'dra yod na gra sgrig byas chog a zhang rnams yang bskyar gdan la 'khod pa na ston mo'i mgo dngos su rtsom/ tshul 'di ston chen zhig yin na de ltar bgyi bar bshad/ de yang bsdus te bshad na/ a zhang gtso bo de gral mgo yar sgyid du 'dug pa dang ston 'go 'dzin mkhan ni mar sgyid du tsog mag pa yin na a zhang rnams dang mnyam du gral rked du tshul 'dug(mgo bo smad cing sna phu thung byas pa'i 'dug srog zhig)byed pa dang / mna' ma yin na g.yon khyim gyi mar sgyid du bag rogs dang lhan du tshul 'dug byed/ thog mar ston 'go 'dzin mkhan gyis gtam bshad/ de rjes gral mgo'i a zhang gtso bo des gtam bshad/ 'dir de gnyis kyi gtam bshad srol rnams bsdus/ de mur mthud nas rdzong ba'am rang ster/ yang mna' ma yin na yang bskyar gdan la 'khod pa'i dus der ja gsar ba zhig bskol nas mna' mar mchod kha 'phen du 'jug de'i don ni nyi ma de nas bzung gnas khyim de'i thab mgo'i sla nga thom bu dang bcas pa rang gi bu mo lta bu'i mna' ma der gtad pa yin tshul bstan pa'o// mag pa yin na/ gtam bshad rnams tshar rjes/ mag skegs bcings pa dang / de'i 383
mtshon bya ni nyi ma de nas bzung rang gi bu dang khyad par med pa'i bsam pa bstan thog bu las kyang lhag pa zhig yong bar smon 'dun zhus pa yin/ klu len gar rtsed kyi skabs su dang po nye ya'i phyogs nas a zhang rnams la lta ba byed/thog mar phyogs gnyis kyis glu yag(glu gzhas)len/ dus tshod nges can zhig la slebs pa na klu btsog(la gzhas)gi mgo rtsom/ glu 'gran shugs 'gran sogs rtsed mo rtse/ nyin 'dir a zhang tshang la dbang che bas/ nye ya tshang gi phyogs nas phal cher yod tshad kho tsho dang bstun dgos/ de bas kha dpe la yang / bkur dgos pa nyin gcig gi a zhang yin la/ gces dgos pa tshe gcig gi pha ma yin zhes grags/ klu len gar rtsed kyi dus su mna' ma'am mag pa logs su phub pa'i bag sbre'u(sbos)dang mag sbre'u ru 'dug dgong mor a zhang rnams mal du nyal ba dang / nangs mor snga mo nas phyir log lam du chas khar nye ya tshang gi phyogs nas a zhang rnams kyi rta la sga bstod pa dang / bsang gtong / gong chang drangs te skyel ma byed/ ston mo mjug sgril ba'i phyi nyin gnyen tshang gis slar yang ston mo bshams shing / ston 'dzin pa tshang mar skyes 'bul dang bcas te lam la 'jug de la rdul sprugs kyi nyin yang zer ro// de bas gnyen ston zhig gi go rim spyi khog tsam bshad na 'di lta ste/ dang po a zhang rnams bsus te mchod kha 'phen dang / gnyis pa 'bab rten len pa/ gsum pa a zhang rnams khyim du bsu ba/ bzhi ba g.yang 'bod byed pa/ lnga ba ja mchod byed pa/ drug pa 'go 'dzin gnyis kyis gtam bshad pa/ bdun pa mag pa'am bu'i rdzong ba ste rang ster ba/brgyad pa ston bshad dang mag skegs bcings pa/ dgu ba chu dar slong ba/ bcu ba a zhang tshang la klu'i lta ba byed pa/ bcu gcig pa phyogs gnyis kyis glu len 384
gar rtse byed pa/ bcu gnyis pa a zhang la skyel ma dang bcas legs skyes 'bul ba/ bcu gsum pa 'go 'dzin gnyis kyis slar yang gtam bshad pa/ mjug mthar bsang gtong ba dang bcas a zhang tshang('di la gnyen tshang tshang yang zer)la skyel ma byed do// 'di ni mag ston zhig gi go rim yin la/ bag ston gyi go rim yang bu mo'i skra phab tshul dang bag ras slong tshul ma gtogs spyi'i go rim phal cher gong dang mtshungs so//drug mtshod bshams sogs kyi skor bshadapa/ru sde 'dis kyang bod gangs can gyi gang zag phal mo che dang 'dra bar nang ba sangs rgyas kyi chos la dad pa byed cing / nam yin yang dkon mchog gsum gtsug tu bkur ba dang mchod pa rgya chen po byed/ de yang ru sde 'di'i yab mes gong ma rnams kyis dus nam zhig nas bzung nang ba'i chos lugs 'di dang du blangs pa ha cang bshad dka' mod/ ru sde 'di'i chad khungs sogs la gzhigs na/ dang thog sa skya pa'i lugs rnams gtso bor byed par mngon la/ dus der sa skya'i lugs ltar chos thog sogs kyang 'dzin pas/ blon chos ban sngags kyi bca' yig las/ bcu ba'i lnga mchod kyi chos thog la/ bong stag tsho ba gsum tshes nyer brgyad dang / lnga ba'i ma ga chos thog la tshes dgu'i nyin bong stag tsho ba gsum zhes bkod yod pa rnams las/ ru sde 'dis sngar nas chos thog 'dzin pa dang chos thog gi nang don gyi cha nas kyang sa skya'i lugs kho na ma yin par 'phel rgyas chen po byung yod pa mtshon thub/ de rjes reb gong phyogs su yab rje bla ma shar skal ldan rgya mtsho sogs mdo smad kyi bla chen mang pos nang ba'i bstan pa ches cher spel bas ru sde 'di la yang nang ba'i chos lugs kyi thad nas sngar bas kyang lhag pa'i bag chags zab mo zhig bzhag pa dang dus der dge ldan pa'i lugs la 385
dad bkur byas/ de'i phyis su rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas ru sde 'dis ru spo gnas 'grim mang po byas kyang / lo ltar spyi pa 'dzin pa'i srol dag ma nyams par bskyangs pa dang / rwa rgya dgon pa btab pa'i skabs de shed na/ rma rgyal sbom ra'i nye 'dabs su yod pa'i ru sde 'di'i tsho ba skor zhig dang bong stag dpon po ru lo sogs yon bdag la bud de mthun rkyen sbyar/ de nas bzung ra rgya dang byang phyogs kyi chos sde dag gi bar chos 'brel byung / de rjes skyabs gcig shing bza' rdo rje 'chang chen pos bong stag dgon pa btab pa dang dbang lung mang po gsungs pas/ ru sde 'dis nang chos rgya chen spel bar skul 'ded kyi nus pa thon/de nas bye brag tsho ba 'ga' zhig gis kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spel ched dgon pa btab/ dper na/ gra tsha'i dgon pa dang / nywa nag dgon pa/ dpa' skyong dgon pa lta bu'o// tsho dgon de dag las dar rgyas cung byung ba ni gra tsha'i dgon pa yin la/ dgon sde 'di'i 'don bca' kha phyag len rnams snga 'gyur rnying ma ba'i lugs la gtogs/ rang re'i bod du rnying ma bar lo rgyus shin tu ring bo yod kyang / ru sde 'dir rnying ma ba'i lugs srol rnams dar ba ha cang 'phyis/ gtso bo gter ston rin po che dang gdong dpyad bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rnams ru sde 'dir byon pa'i ring la dar ba red/ de bas bong stag dgon pa dang grwa tsha'i dgon pa sogs ni de dag gi mtshon byed byas chog go/ de ltar mdzo brjod tsam gleng nas mchod bshams sogs kyi skor bshad pa la/ dang po mchod bshams bshad pa/ mchod bshams la dgon pa'i mchod bshams dang khyim gzhi'i mchod bshams gnyis yod de/ 'di nas snga ma bsdus de phyi ma cung zad gleng na/ dud khyim phyug po dang dbul bo gang zhig yin na'ang / thang ga dang li 386
sku sogs mang po bzhugs su gsol nas de rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ 'di la gzhi chos kyang zer/ sngon dus dud khrim rnams kyi gzhi chos gtso bo ni thang ga dang chos dpe rnams yin pas/ thang ga'i rigs la ston pa'i thang ga dang / rje yab sras gsum gyi thang ga sgrol ma dkar sngon gyi thang ga 'od dpag med kyi thang ga rgyal ba paṇa chen gyi thang ga slob dpon rin po che'i thang ga sogs yod pa dang / da dung chos skyong srung ma'i thang ga'ang yod/ thang ga la gos thang dang shog thang sogs mi 'dra ba yod kyang gos thang legs par baji/ de la bshams khebs dang bshams lag sprod/ de min ston pa dang / sgrol ma sogs kyi li sku dang / zangs sku/ gser sku/ dngul sku chung ba'i rigs kyang mchis la li sku dang zangs sku mang / chos dpe la bskal bzang dang / brgya stong pa/ gser 'od/gzungs bsdus/ bka' thang / mdo gdugs sgrol gsum gyi kha ton sogs mchis/bla grwa rnams kyi sku 'dra yang de rnams dang lhan du bzhugs su gsol/ ru 'gel ba'i skabs su de rnams sgam snod du 'jug pa dang dus rgyun g.yas khyim gyi ya logs su bshams shing mchod pa 'bul/ spyir gzhi chos kyi skor 'di med pa'i khyim tshang med na'ang / de'i mang nyung sogs tshad gzhi gcig tu ma nges/ dpon po dang phyug po'i dud khyim rnams la chos dpe dang thang ga sogs mja zhing dbul po rnams la cung zad nyung / dung ru la zangs kyi dung ru dang li yi dung ru sogs yod cing / dung ru la 'di ga'i kha skad du 'theb tse zer/ dung ru dang rkong bu ni mchod pa 'bul byed kyi yo chas gtso bo yin pas/ de dag med pa'i khyim tshang med/ rkong bu la brgya rkong dang mtshan thub sogs yo da kyang / dud khyim zhig la mtshon na brgya rkong mang zhing mtshan thub nyung / mchod mar btsag thag chod pa 387
byed/ mar len dus mchod mar logs su len/ sdong rkang bal dang rtswa yis byed/sdong rkang bca' skabs g.yas nas g.yon la skor/ mchod me sgron skabs mi gtsang ba dang ser sna byed pa/ kha rlangs sogs la ha cang gzab/ mchod me sgron payi 'di ga'i kha skad du mchod me 'jog zer/ mchod pa 'bul dus dung ru bdun tshar gcig la brtsi/ khrim tshang mang che bas nam rgyun bdun tshar gcig bshams pa dang / bdun tshar gnyis dang gsum sogs bshams mkhan yang yod/ ji ltar mang na de ltar bzang / nangs mor bshams shing dgong mor bsdu/ nyi ma sum brgya drug cur de ltar chag pa med par bshams/ mchod me ni khyim tshang mang che bas tshes bzang dang dus chen sogs kyi skabs su 'jog pa dang / dud khyim la las dgong grangs la 'jog pa'ang yod do// gnyis pa/ bsang gtong tshul bshad pa/ 'dir yang dgon pa'i bsang gtong tshul re zhig bzhag ste khyim gzhi'i bsang gtong skor cung zad bshad na/ ru sde 'dir mtshon na bsang mi phud pa'i dud khyim gcig kyang med pas/ bsang phud sar rdo ba'i bsang khri rtsig bsang khri mang che ba'i dbyibs ni gor god yin zhing gru bzhi yang mchis/ bsang khri tshang ma sbra'i gnya' stag gam phug stod du jig pa las mkhal dang sgo kha ru rtsig pa'i srol med/dus rgyun mchod pa'i chos skyong dang gzhi bdag rnams ni spyi phyogs nas bod gangs can gyi chos skyong sung ma rnams te/ dkar phyogs kyi lha'am nang ba sangs rgyas kyi chos skyong srung ma rnams yin la/ de rnams las bye brag tu rma chen sbom ra dang / khri shog rgyal mo/ rdor legs/ rgyal po/ rgyal mo/ lha mo/ yul lha/ bag rtse sogs mchod pa ma zad/ ru sde 'di'i skyes lha rus lha sogs te brag ser dang /brag skya rgod rtse/ brag dkar rnams kyang mchod/ mdor bsdus na bsang mchod 388
las/ sa 'di la gnas pa'i sa bdag mchod/ yul 'di la gnas pa'i gzhi bdag mchod ces pa ltar/ hang nge'i ri rgan mthon po dang / dbus kyi tshwa mtsho dkar mo// 'os shing bal shing / brag dkar them chen/ a mes bo ro/ gangs dkar phyogs las rnam rgyal sogs kyang mchod do// yang bye brag dud khyim re res sung ma bsten tshul la khyad par cung zad mchis mod/ phal che bas lha mo dang /rgyal po/ mgon po/ gza' sogs mchod pa dang / the'u ring mchod pa'ang yod par bshad/ bsang khar 'bud pa dang gnyen slong ba bcas kyi skabs su sung ma gcig min la ha cang gzab cing gcigs mthong byed/ sa cha dang sde ba mi gcig na lhag par de ltar yin/ bsang gtong tshul la ri bsang dang yul bsang gnyis yod de/ ri bsang ni gnas ri 'gangs chen dag tu phyin nas bsang gtong ba la zer ba dang / yul bsang ni gzhi khyim nas phud pa'i bsang gtong la zer bas/gzhi bsang zhes kyang bya/ da dung spyi bsang gtong ba yang yod/ de ni gtso bo sde ba'i skyes pa thams cad mnyam du tshogs de chos thog sogs kyi skabs su'am ri mgor song nas thun mong gis bsang gtong ba la zer ro// ri bsang dang / yul bsang / spyi bsang gang yin yang bsang khri'i steng nas gtong / 'di ga'i kha skad du bsang gtong ba la bsang phud zer/ spyi bsang gtong ba'i bsang khri che ba dang ha lam sbra tshad lta bu yod/ yul bsang gtong ba'i bsang khri chung / bsang gtong dus 'bul bya gtso bo nas dang shug pa/ ja/ mar sogs mnyam du bsres ba zhig yin zhing / de la bsang rtsi zer/ lo sar dang dus chen gyi skabs su chang dang /rgun 'brum/ ka ra/ ko re phud ba'ang yod mod/ gtan nas mi rung ba ni sha khrag gi rigs te dmar 'gro mi nyan pa de yin/ ri bsang dang spyi bsang lo rer 389
thengs re gnyis las mi gtong / yul bsang ni dud khyim mang che bas nyin ltar gtong bas/ de la rgyun bsang yang zer/ gzhi khyim nas kyang ri bsang gtong mod/ grangs tshad rnams gcig tu ma nges/ spyir bsang gtong mkhan skyes pa rnams yin yang / yul bsang yin na chag mi nyan pa'i ched du skyes pho mo khyad med kyis gtong ba dang bong stag ྅ nag dang 'dra na skyes mas bsang gtong srol dar snga bar bshad/ bsang gtong ba'i dus kyi cha nas nangs bsang dang dgong bsang gnyis su phye la/ spyi bsang dang ri bsang yin na nangs mor gtong ba dang / yul bsang yin na nangs dgong gi khyad par chen po med kyang gtso bo nyin der bsang gtong rgyu chag mi nyan pa de yin/ bsang gtong ba'i sngon la bsang rtsi sla nga'i nang du ngo len pa dang / de nas ha cang gtsang ma byed/ bsang gtong skabs bsang rtsi dkal yol dang bsang khom la 'jal nas 'bul/ rgyun bsang yin na bsang rtsi dkal yol gang dang yang na bsang khem du ma gtong /ri bsang dang / spyi bsang / bca' ba sogs kyi skabs su bsang grangs len dgos na bsang rtsi dkar yol gsum bsang grangs stong dang / lnga ni khri/ bdun ni 'bum/ bcu gcig sa ya/ bcu gsum bye bar brtsi/ bsang gtong dus kyi cho ga gtso bo ni bsang gtong mkhan gyis bsang khri la g.yas skor rgyag dung 'bud/bsang mchod rtsi/ spyi bsang dang ri bsang gi skabs su skyes pa mang pos lhan du 'i ki bswo barsā'i skad rgyag pa dang / bsang mchod ji ba/ chos skyong dang gzhi bdag bye brag pa rnams kyi mtshan nas bos te sa yang 'gul ba lta bu byed/ de bas sngon dus skyes pa zhig yin na bsang mchod rtsi mi shes pa med do// gsum pa/dar lcog 'then tshul bshad pa/ ru sde 'di la yang rang re'i bod mi rnams dang 390
'dra bar sngar nas dar rtsog 'then pa'i srol 'dug dar lcog zer ba ni kha dog mi 'dra ba'i ras dkar sngo ser gsum gyi steng du chos kyi yi ge dpar te 'then pa zhig yin pas/ de la yang ri dar sgo dar zhes pa'i khyad par yod/ ri dar ni ri bo gnas pa can gyi rtse mo dang dud khyim rnams kyi phug stod kyi rgyab ri'i steng du 'then pa'i dar lcog la bya ba dang / sgo dar ni khyim tshang gang de'i sbra sgo ru 'then pa'i dar lcog la zer/ ri dar mang che ba ka ba'i steng la btags nas 'then pa dang / skabs 'gar brag dang nags la brten pa'ang yod/ sgo dar ni tha gus bzung ste sbra sgo ru 'phred du 'then la/ ka bar btags te 'then pa'ang yod/spyir dar rtsog 'then pa de ni chos sgrub stangs gal chen zhig yin pas mi tshang mas shin tu mthong chen byed/ 'on kyang dar lcog gang 'dod ltar 'then pa'i srol med/ dud khyim zhig dang yang na mi zhig gis dar lcog 'then dgos byung na ma 'then pa'i sngon la/ ci zhig gi don du dar lcog 'then pa dang / dar lcog ga 'dra zhig yin dgos pa/ gnas gang du 'then dgos pa sogs bla mar lung bstan zhu/ de bas dar rtsog gi rigs la rgyal mtshan rtse mo dang / ma ṇi/ bsam pa lhun grub ma/ mdo gdugs sgrol gsum/ gu ru si lhu/ 'od dpag g.yas skor rgyag dung 'bud/ bsang mchod rtsi/ spyi bsang dang ri bsang gi skabs su skyes pa mang pos lhan du khri gi bswo bzhwa'i skad rgyag pa dang / bsang mchod rtsi ba/ chos skyong dang gzhi bdag bye brag pa rnams kyi mtshan nas bos te sa yang 'gul ba lta bu byed/ de bas sngon dus skyes pa zhig yin na bsang mchod rtsi mi shes pa med do//gsum pa/ dar lcog 'then tshul bshad pa/ ru sde 'di la yang rang re'i bod mi rnams dang 'dra bar sngar nas dar lcog 'then pa'i srol 'dug dar lcog zer ba 391
ni kha dog mi 'dra ba'i ras dkar sngo ser gsum gyi steng du chos kyi yi ge dpar te 'then pa zhig yin pas/ de lu yang ri dar sgo dar zhes pa'i khyad par yod/ ri dar ni ri bo gnas pa can gyi rtse mo dang dud khyim rnams kyi phug stod kyi rgyab ri'i steng du 'then pa'i dar lcog la bya ba dang / sgo dar ni khyim tshang gang de'i sbra sgo ru 'then pa'i dar lcog la zer/ ri dar mang che ba ka ba'i steng la btags nas 'then pa dang / skabs 'gar brag dang nags la brten pa'ang yod/ sgo dar ni tha gus bzung ste spra sgo ru 'phred du 'then la/ ka bar btags te 'then pa'aja yod/ spyir dar lcog 'then pa de ni chos sgrub stangs gal chen zhig yin pas mi tshang mas shin tu mthong chen byed/ 'on kyang dar lcog gang 'dod ltar 'then pa'i srol med/ dud khyim zhig dang yang na mi zhig gis dar lcog 'then dgos byung na ma 'then pa'i sngon la/ ci zhig gi don du dar lcog 'then pa dang / dar lhog ga 'dra zhig yin dgos pa/ gnas gang du 'then dgos pa sogs bla mar lung bstan zhu/ de bas dar lcog gi rigs la rgyal mtshan rtse mo dang / ma rṇa/bsam pa lhun grub ma/ mdo gdugs sgrol gsum/ gu ru si dhu/ 'od dpag btsim pa dang mgo rnga gnyis nas thig sne 'jog dar rtsog 'then skabs dar mgo'i thig sne ni dar shing gi rtse mor 'dogs shing dar rnga'i thig sne sa ngos kyi phur bar 'dogs/ dar lce dar tshon lngas byed la/ dar tshon lnga ni sngon po dang / dkar po/dmar po/ ser po/ ljang gu bcas yin/ de rnams kyis nam mkha' dang / chu bo/sa gzhi/ me lce/ rlung ste 'byung ba lnga mtshon/ dar lce ni dar rtsog gi mdun du btsim ste sbyor ba dang / ring tshad la mtho gang dang zheng la sor lnga yod/ dar lcog gi mdun mgo nas thog mar sngon po dang de nas sa chu me rlung rnams kyi rim 392
pa ltar 'dogs/ mjug mthar rab gnas byed pa dang nyin bzang skar bzang zhig la gtad de ri'am sgo sogs su 'then/ bzhi ba/ lab rtse bstod tshul bshad pa/ de yang lab rtse bstod tshul bshad pa la/— ru sde 'dir yang snga mo nas lab rtse bstod pa'i srol mchis pa dang / lab rtse ni phal cher thun mong gis bstod pas/lab rtse ma bstad pa'i gong la skyes pa mang pos gros byed/ de nas bla ma sogs zhus te sa dpyad legs par mdzad nas lab rtse rtsig lab rtse rtsig yul mang shos ri bo'i rtse sogs yin yang de ni ri bo ha cang che ba'am mthon po yin dgos pa'i nges pa med do// ri bo gnas pa can gyi steng du jig pa dang khor yug sogs gang thad nas legs pa'i ri chung rnams su'ang jig spyir lab rtse rtsig pa'i gnas yin na/ sa bab kyi thad nas gnas gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa 'di tsam yin dgos/ phyogs kun tu bltas na lta lam yangs pa dang / sa bab kyi dbang gis thams cad pang du bzung ba lta bu/ nyi 'od yin na 'char sla sa/ mun pa yin na dwangs sla sa/ dgra yin na sngon lon sa/ grogs yin na 'jug bde sa/ lam rgya'i sne mo 'du sa/ sa brgya'i lte ba nyan sa/ grogs kyi dpung rtsa nyan sa/ dgra yi snying sha 'dar sa/ kun gyi yid smon 'chor sa ste/ mdor na phyogs thams cad las rnam par du rgyal ba lta bu'i gnas shig yin dgos par bshad/ lab rtse'i 'og tu gser dang / dngul/ g.yu byur/ mu tig zangs lcags sogs rin po che sna tshogs dang / mda' dang / mdung / gri/ phub/ khrab sogs go mtshon sna tshogs sbas nas gter rim pa gsum las mi nyung ba 'jog de rnams kyi steng du rdo dang shing dang sa sogs go rim dang ldan par byas te gnon zhing mthar rmu thag gis mang du dkri ba dang dar lcog sogs kyis kyang brgyan/ ru sde 'di'i spyi'i lab rtse 393
ni brag ser lab rtse yin la/ de'i skor sngon chad bris rin/ da dung bye brag tsho ba rnams la yang lab rtse yod/ dper na/ lha nag lab rtse dang / gra tsha'i lab rtse/nag bza'i lab rtse sogs lta bu'o// lab rtse lo rer thengs gcig bstod pa dang /bstod pa'i skabs su bsang chen gtong / de yang nyin bzang skar bzang zhig la bstod dgos pas/ ru sde 'dir mtshon na spyir btang gis bzhi ba'i bcu gcig dang brgyad pa'i bco lngar bstod pa mang / dus der mi mang po 'dzoms pas/sngon chad lab rtse bstod pa'i skabs dang bstun nas sde don sogs la gros mol byed par bshad/ gong bshad ltar lab rtse ni thun mong gis bstod pa zhig yin yang / re 'gar dud khyim gyis kyang bstod pas/ thog ma'i dus shig la mi che ge mo dang dud khyim gyis bstod pa dang / de nas rigs rus gcig pa'i khyim rgyud rnams dang / rim bzhin sde ba'am tsho ba thun mong gis bstod pa zhig tu gyur bar mngon la/ de ni brag ser lab rtse'i lo rgyus las kyang shes thub bo// zhar byung gter 'jog tshul/ gter 'jog tshul la rigs mang po yod mod/ ru sde 'dir mtshon na mtsho gter dang / ri gter/ khyim gter 'dzog pa'i srol rnams gtso bo yin/ sngon dus bod sog gi bla dpon rnams dang phyug po mang pos mtsho gter 'jog pas/ bong stag dpon po tshe kho dang / dkon bho/ dpal bzang so so'i ring la ru sde 'di'i bla dpon dang phyug po rnams mtsho sngon por phyin nas mtsho gter 'jog ces bgres po rnams kyi ngag las thos/ ri gter 'jog srol de yang sngon nas yod pas/ sngon chad ru sde 'dis rma chen sbom ra dang / chu sngon/hang nga / dbus kyi tshwa mtsho dkar mo/ brag dkar them chen/ bkra shis 'byung gnas/ gangs dkar phyogs las rnam rgyal sogs su gter bzhag pa'i lo rgyus 394
yod/ khyim gter ni khyim sger gyis bzhag pa'i gter la zer ba dang / sngon chad khyim gter 'jog mkhan gyi khrod du dpon po dang phyug po mang zhing dbul bo dang med po nyung / sde ba thun mong gis bzhag na de la spyi gter zer/ spyi gter dang /ri gter/ khyim gter gang yin yang de rnams rang dgar mi 'jog par/ bla ma sogs la zhu zhing sa dpyad legs par mdzad pa dang / gter 'jog pa'i nyi ma la yang dpyad/ gter rdzas la gser dang / dngul/ g.yu/ byu ru/ mu tig sogs rin po che sna tshogs 'jog la/ de dag kyang gter khug dang yang na gter sgam sogs su bcug ste sa 'og tu sbed/ shul rnams mi snang bar byed/ bod 'dir gzhan gyi gter 'dru srol mi dar la/ ru sde 'di yangang de ltar ro//bdun/ sung rtags sogs kyi skor bshad pa/de yang rta rnar lug la sung rtags 'dogs pa dang tshe thar la gtong tshul cung zad bshad na/ bshad rgyun la mi yis mi 'dod na tsha dang phyugs la mi yong god kha zer ba ltar/ dus rtag tu phyugs la god kha mi yong ba dang / gcan gzan sogs kyi 'jigs pa sel ba/ bor stor dang bar chad sogs mi yong ba'i ched du rta dang / rnar lug sogs la sung rtags 'dogs/ srung rtags bzo ba'am sgril tshul ni dar dang ras yin na kha dog dmar ser dkar sngo'i gos dang ras dras nas de dag gi mgo sne gcig tu bsdus te rdo rje mdud pa rgyag de la dar tshon sna lnga'i sung rtags zer/ bal skud yin na skud pa cung zad ring zhing sbom po zhig g.yas la bkal te nyis khugs sum khugs byas nas de'i mgo la rdo rje mdud pa rgyag pa dang / da dung de'i sne la tsor lo lta bu'i bal yang 'dogs/sngon dus dar tshon sna lnga'i sung rtags nyung zhing mang ma bal skud kyis byed par bshad/ sung rtags bzos rjes rab gnas byed pa dang / de nas nyin bzang 395
skar bzang la gtad de nor lug rnams la sung rtags 'dogs/ de yang rta nor lug gsum yod tshad la sung rtags 'dogs pa zhig min par/ dud khyim zhig gis rang gi sgo phyugs rnams las khyad par can skor zhig gdam ste sung rtags 'dogs/ g.yang rta g.yang nor g.yang lug yin na lhag par de ltar yin/ lo ltar sung kha gso ba dang de shi rjes yang bskyar sgo phyugs gzhan zhig la srung rtags 'dogs/ spyir rta mang che bar sung rtags 'dogs pa dang / nor lug la srung rtags 'dogs tshul gong bshad ltar yin rna// sgo zog tshe thar la gtong tshul ni/ ru sde 'di'i srol lugs ltar na nor dang / lug dang / ra ma tshe thar la gtong ba las rta ni tshe thar la btang ba yin zhes bshad srol med la/ rnar lug ra ma tshe thar la btang rjes de rnams la yang sung rtags 'dogs/ de yang sgo phyugs rnams la sung rtags 'dogs pa dang tshe thar la gtong ba der nang don gyi cha nas phyogs 'di dag 'du ste/ gcig ni gong bshad ltar phyugs la god kha mi yong ba dang g.yang kha rgyas pa sogs kyi ched du nor lug sogs la srung rtags btags pa yin pas/ sung rtags la 'jigs skyob kyi sung rtags dang / god kha zlog pa'i srung rtags/ g.yang kha 'phel ba'i srung rtags sogs rigs mang po yod/gnyis ni chos skyong srung ma'am yul lha gzhi bdag rnams dgyes pa'i ched du'am yang na dud khyim gang de dus rtag tu de rnams kyis mi lhod par srung ste bkra shis par gnas pa'i slad du sgo phyugs rnams tshe thar la btang nas sung rtags btags pa yin/ dper na/ lha mo la 'then pa dang / rgyal po la 'then pa/mgon po la 'then pa/ brag ser la 'then pa sogs lta bu'o// gsum ni mi la nad tsha dang phyugs la god kha byung ba'i dus su de dag gi rkyen ngan dang bar chad 396
sogs sel ba'i phyir du nor lug sogs tshe thar la btang ba yin/ de bas nor lug tshe thar la gtong dus mang che ba ni bla ma mo ba rtsis pa sogs la lung bstan zhus te tshe thar la gtong / yang na tsha sogs ma byung na'ang dud khyim nas bar chad dang bgegs sogs mi 'byung ba'am 'gog pa'i ched du rang 'gul gyis bla mar zhus te tshe thar la gtong ba'ang yod/ bzhi ni sdig pa mi bsag pa'i slad du'o// mdor na/ tshe thar la gtong dus kyang nyin bzang tshes bzang la dpyad pa dang / tshe thar la btang rjes bsha' ba dang btsong ba ster ba sogs kyi srol med/tha na bor stor du song yang sgo zog gzhan dang mi mtshungs par ci thub gang nus kyis 'tshol lo//brgyad/ dmangs khrod rtsom rig skor bshad pa/dmangs khrod rtsom rig gi skor nas ha cang phun sum tshogs shing dar khyab che ba ni dmangs gzhas dang / gtam dpe/ khod/ gtam rgyud/ ston bshad sogs yin zhing / dmangs gzhas kyi skor nas ru sde 'di'i lugs srolta ltar byas na rigs gnyis su phye ba ste/ 'di ga'i yul mi rnams kyi skad cha ltar bshad na de la glu yag dang glu btsog zer/ glu yag ni ston mo sogs mi mang po 'dus pa'i khrod nas blangs chog pa'i bstod glu dang / shags glu/ dri glu la zer ba dang / klu btsog ni ri nas len pa'i la gzhas la zer zhing / skabs 'gar 'di la glu rgan zhes kyang brjod pa dang / ston mo'i skabs su pha a khu zhang bo dang / ma sru rgan gras/ ming sring nye du thams cad la gnang ba zhus te dmigs gsal gyi rol rtsed cig tu byas na glu rgan yang blangs chog go dmangs klu'i brjod bya'i cha nas bshad na/ bstod klu dad / shags glu/ dri klu/ la gzhas bcas su 'du ba dang /de dag la'ang brjod bya'i dbang gis nang gses kyi dbye ba du ma dgar rgyu yod 397
de/ la gzhas la cha bzhag na nang gses su rtse mgo dang / mthun pa/ lab/'gal ba/ skyon/ bde mo 'jog pa bcas kyi khyad par yod pa lta bu yin pas 'dir re re nas bsdus so// gtam rdaba'i skor nas/ sngon chad bong stag 'di la gtam bshad par mkhas pa'i rgan po mang po yod zer/ gtam bshad na gtam dpe dang 'bral thabs med pas/ dmangs khrod du zab zhugs byas na gtam dpe rmong po thos rgyu yod la/ gtam dpe'i brjod bya'i cha nas gnyen bshad skor gyi gtam dpe dang / thon skyed dang 'tsho ba'i skor gyi gtam dpe/ bar bsdums skor gyi gtam dpe/ kha shom 'then pa'i skor gyi gtam dpe/ bslab bya dang gnas lugs ston pa'i skor gyi gtam dpe sogs te nang don ha cang rgya che zhing phun sum tshogs so// dmangs khrod gtam rgyud kyi skor nas/ sngon chad ru sde 'di'i rgan gzhon pho mo byis pa thams cad gtam rgyud bshad pa'am gtam rgyud la nyan par dga' zhing / gtam rgyud bshad pa la nam rgyun gna' gtam bshad pa zhes brjod pa dang / gtam rgyud dam gna' gtam mang che ba zhig gi brjod bya dang rnam pa ni ru sde 'di na bshad kyin yod pa rnams kyang mtsho sngon po'i mtha' skor du gnas pa'i 'brog sde rnams su khyab yod pa'i gna' gtam dag dang khyad par cher med pa dang / skor zhig ni(mi ro rtse sgrubadang(ro sgrubabacas su bkod yod pa rnams dang 'dra'o// khod mang po 'dug la/ byis pa rnams khod bshad rgyur shin tu dga'/ sgrung gi skor nas gtso bona'adzam gling spyi bsagyadang /(rta rgyug rgyal 'jogi(ho gling g.yul 'gyes('jang gling g.yul 'gyes(bdud gling g.yul 'gyegirnams yin zhing / 'di ga'i mi rnams sgrung la nyan par spro ba dang sgrung bshad mkhan yang mang mod/ 'on kyang sgrung ba de rnams ni bslab ste 398
shes pa'i sgrung ba'i rigs su gtogs pa las sgrung bab pa'i sgrung ba min pa 'dra'o/ston bshad kyi skor nas bstod tshig brjod pa dang / mag skegs bcings pa chu dar slong ba/ bag ras slong ba rnams su 'du la/ de min dmangs khrod rtsom rig gi skor nas da dung gnas bstod thar thor dang kha mtshar brjod pa'i ngag rtsom mang po thos rgyu yod de/ yul mi tshos kha mtshar brjod pa'i ngag rtsom de la btags sa byed pa zhes brjod pa dang / brjod bya'i cha nas bstod pa dang / smad pa/ 'phya ba/ zur za sogs su dbye chog go/ gzhan yang 'di ga'i dmangs khrod du sngon chad rta rgyug pa dang / mda' 'phen pa/ mdung rtsal sbyong ba/ 'jig 'ded pa/ sho rgyag pa/ 'ba' 'debs pa/ rtse mgo bsdu ba sogs te rol rtsed kyi byed sgo spel ba'i srol lugs rnams cung zad dar bar mngon mod/ 'on kyang dmangs khrod du rtse rigs rtsed pa zhes pa'i bshad srol tsam zhig yod pa las don la zhabs bro 'khrab pa dang / rtsed mo rtse ba/ bod kyi dus chen so sor rol ba'i srol ha cang nyung ba 'dra'o//dgu/ dur srol bshadapa/de yang ru sde 'di'i dur srol skor cung zad bshad na/ mi shi ba'i bem ro ri la g.yel ba las sbyin sreg byed pa dang chu la skyur ba nyung / mi che chung gang zhig tshe las 'das na'ang bla mar zhu ba dang chos bca'/ bla mar zhu tshul ni/ gshin po gang de 'da' kha'am 'das rjes bsngo rten phul nas bla mar gtad pa dang yang na bla ma rang khyim du gdan 'dren zhu/ de la sngas mgo'i bla ma zer/ chos bca' tshul gtso bo zhig ni mi tshe las 'das pa na grwa ba bdun zhus nas nyin bdun gyi ring la chos 'don pa dang / gal te grwa ba bdun la ma long na gsum gyis 'don pa'ang yod la/ skabs der zhus yong ba'i sngas mgo'i bla ma yang grwa ba de rnams kyi 399
grangs gras su 'jog de la bdun 'ded pa zhes bya'o// bla ma dang grwa ba gang yang zhu ma thub na bsngo rten phul ba'i bla ma'i zhal gsung ltar bca' ba rnams dgon pa la gtad/ de dang mnyam du nyin zhag bdun gyi ring gshin po'i nye du rnams dang / khyim mtshes ru skor/ tha na sde ba'i mi mang po'ang yong ste 'khor lo bskor/dus der smyung gnas srung ba dang ma ga mang po 'don la/ bdun 'ded pa'i skabs su ma ṇi yang bskul/ nyin zhag zhe dgu'i bar mchod me mi chag par 'jog cing tsha gsur mang po phud/ de'i ring bca' ba thams cad kyang 'grub par byed/da dung gshin por dge rtsa sgrub ched dgon sde du mar 'gro ba'am bla ma mang po'i mdun sar bsngo rten 'khyer/ spyir gshin por dge rtsa sgrub na bca' ba thams cad gzhi nas 'grub na rab yin yang / de ltar ma nus na dgon pa sogs la gtad de 'grub par byas kyang byin rlabs ni mnyam par bshad/ de bas khyim tshang ga 'dra zhig yin na'ang gshin por chos chen po bca' ba dang 'gro sgo yang mang du gtong / dper na/ bla mar bsngo rten phul ba dang / bdun 'ded kyi yon/bca' ba dgon gtad kyi yon/ dgon par song nas brgya mchod dang stong mchod 'jog pa/ mang ja skol ba/ 'gyed rgyag pa sogs lta bu'o// yang skar ma la bgrod tshul dang 'dun byed tshul sogs bshad na/ sngon dus mi shi ba'am tshe las 'das na de'i bem ro la nyar tshags legs po byas te bdun ded rjes dur sar skyel/'di ga'i mi rnams kyis dur sa la gnas sa zer/ dbyar dus sogs su bem ro yun ring por 'jog dka' bas nyi ma du ma las mi 'jog la/ dgun dus nyi ma long ba'i bar du 'jog zam ro gnas sar (dur sa'i don)skyel ba la 'di ga'i kha skad du skar ma byed zer/ bem ro nyar tshags byed tshul ni/ mi shi ba'am tshe 400
las 'das rjes lus drod yongs su yal ba na zam ro la nyar tshags byed/ de yang thog mar bem ro'i mgrin pa dar gos dang yang na kha btags kyis sdom pa dang de'i zhor la rgyan gros kyang bshu/ bem po ni snyom pa brang khar stor zhing tsog pa'i tshul du 'jog tshul de ltar sdod pa'i ched du tha gu mdun nas rgyab tu blangs te cung zad dom po byas nas sdom/ snga ma ni bem ro'i mgrin las sgra lta bu byung ste mi la 'jigs pa mi ster ba'am de 'dra 'byung ba sogs 'gog pa'i ched du dang /phyi ma ni dus rgyun mi'i 'dug tshul dang mthun pa byas thog gnas sar skyel skabs g.yag la 'gel bde ba'i ched du yin/ bdun 'ded pa'i nyi ma long la nye dus gnas sar lta ru 'gro la/ sa la lta ba'am dpyad pa de ni ha cang gal che ba zhig yin pas shin tu gzab nan byed/ gnas sa'am dur sa rnar na gshin po'i skye —rgyun la gdod pa yong ba ma zad/ de'i nye 'brel dud khyim dang bu rabs tsha rgyud la yang gnod pa shin tu che bar bshad/ dmangs khrod du'ang gnas sa rnar bas dud khyim der phyis su gnod pa byung tshul gyi ngag sgros kyang rgyun du thos rgyu yod/de bas bla ma zhus nas gnas sar dpyad du 'jug pa dang bem ro dur sar skyel dus bla ma'ang phebs/ de la skar ma'i bla ma zer/ 'on kyang skar ma'i bla mar phebs mkhan gyi bla ma nyung la/ dud khyim gang yin zhig gis zhu yang dka' bas/rgad po nyams myong can zhig dang yang na sa la dpyad shes pa'i mi zhig bos te gnas sar dpyad pa mang / gnas sa thams cad ri khrod du byed kyang / de yang ha cang mtho na mi 'os shing shin tu dma' na yang mi rung la/ dper na/ bu mang na gshin po'i gnas sa mtho chog bu nyung na cung zad dma'/ gang ltar rgyab ri gtso la nub phyogs 'gog bla ma dang skyes chen yin na gdung sbyin sreg byed/ sri 401
chen(byis pa)yin na chu la skur/ chur bskur na sri mtshams chod zer/ yang gcig bshad na/ mdun ri dang rgyab ri tshang ba/ sa bab dang khor yug legs pa ste/ sa ni gtsang zhing dben pa dang / bya rgod rnams yong sla sa/ steng nam mkha' dang 'og sa gzhi las gnod pa gzhan nyung sa/ brag rdo dang nags tshal med pa/grag 'gul dang 'jigs pa med pa/ rka lko dang za zur nyung ba zhig yin dgos pa las ri mtho dang / lung rdzubs/ lam kha/ nyag kha/ bde thang sogs su bem po g.yel ba'i srol mi dar/ zam ro skur ba'i skabs su skyes pa yin na g.yas su nyal ba lta bu'i tshul du 'jog pa dang skyes ma yin na g.yon phyogs byed/ mgo bo byang dang rkang ba lho ru ston/ sa bab gzar kha yod na rten rdo 'jog phyag nas gtor/ bem ro dang bar thag cung zad ring po byas te tsha gsur chen po phud ba dang bya rgod 'gug pa'i rmu thag 'then/ tshe 'das kyi gyon pa dang bem ro 'gel byed kyi thag pa sogs bya rgod rnams la 'drogs mi slong ba'i gnas su 'khyer zhing / de nas gri yis dum bur gtubs te 'dor/ bshad tshul la/ bem ro g.yel rjes bya rgod mang po 'khor ba dang / bya rgod de rnams la sne 'dren byas te yong mkhan ni tshe 'das rang gi bla bya yin zhing / bla byas bem ro la kha to so to tsam brgyab pa na bya rgod mang pos skad cig nyid la rus lhag tsam yang med par gtsang za byed zer/ bya rgod myur du bab na las ni bzang zhing bsod nams che bar brtsi/ bya rgod mgyogs por ma bab na las cung zad ngan pa'am rnam smin yongs su ma dag par bshad/ bya rgod gtan nas ma bab pa'am ro langs brgyab na than la brtsi/ bya rgod ma bab na bla mar zhu ba dang / bem ro gtsab mkhan rtog ldan pa sogs ched du zhus te bem ro la yang bskyar nyar tshags byed/ de dus 402
